name: @anw/anw-cli
description: Developer CLI for the ANW AI Content Operating System.

scripts.test: npm run build && node --test dist/tests/generators.test.js dist/tests/repair.test.js

scripts.release:major: npm version major --no-git-tag-version && npm run release:sync
